ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

3. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

4. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.

   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
